description:
STEP 3: uninstall the non-core add-ons on the CURRENT major so the core DB can be upgraded
    cleanly (OpenUpgrade would choke on old-version third-party code). Their columns/tables drop but
    the CORE rows stay, and you already ran addon_data_snapshot - so nothing is lost. ONLY run after
    a successful snapshot. dry_run shows what will be uninstalled; confirm=true does it. Preview-gated.
name: addon_detach
